text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thank goodness...
Rice did her best...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'd like to take 1st place...
J-Just kidding... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'd like to take 1st place...
J-Just kidding... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But you know, Rice thinks she only did her best... because she was with you, Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But you know, Rice thinks she only did her best... because she was with you, Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If it's just Rice alone, I'm totally hopeless, but...
If we're together, I can try even harder...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...So, for the next race...
please train me...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh... U-Umm...
Y-Yeah... I'll do my best next time...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A-As I thought, 1st place is what I should aim for...
I have to try even harder...!
